items.title: Uauá (BA) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #009
items.en_title: Uauá (BA) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #009
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Uauá (BA) is procuring vehicles, transport or related equipment and services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 1,243,016.66; proposals close Nov 27, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
